canada.title: He tried to get into Montreal's kosher market. It led to a battle over alleged meat monopoly
canada.summary: Mendy Boyarsky alleges the Jewish Community Council of Montreal (JCC) is using its market dominance to limit competition to the kosher meat market through its certifier, Montreal Kosher, known as MK Kosher.
